decision_payload.analysis:
As an aggressive momentum trader, I focus on price momentum first. Recent prices show a clear downward trend: 209.45 → 200.40 → 184.36 (consecutive drops, -8% today). This is strong negative momentum, not upward acceleration. 

My portfolio holds a long position (123.09 shares) which is against the current downward trend. The strategy dictates exiting when strong reversal signals (here, the shift to downward momentum) appear. There’s no upward momentum to justify holding or adding to long positions. 

I need to exit the long position to avoid further losses from continuing downward momentum. No reason to buy (trend is down) or hold (against momentum).
